Hi Asha —

Quick note ahead of our renewal window: thanks again for the continued partnership. I pulled a short preflight pack to make the renewal conversation efficient on both sides. Attachments: usage_q4_2027.csv (token breakdown by service), latency_report_q4.pdf (p95 latency trends), mutual_action_plan.docx (timeline + owners).

Key highlights from Q4:
- Monthly token run-rate averaged 2.1B tokens; steady growth driven by inference-heavy features in CareOps.
- Prefix caching reduced per-token cost by ~12% for chat flows after Dec rollouts.
- P95 generation latency improved from 320ms -> 270ms after the quantized model swap.

Questions for your procurement and product teams before we lock proposal:
1) Do you want to move from a 12-month to an 18-month term to capture a steeper prepay discount?
2) Are you planning a 50–75% capacity uplift for Q2 feature launches (we see signals in your asynch job queue)?
3) Any compliance/legal items the finance team will flag for the private deployment addendum?

Proposed next step: 30 min call Wed Jan 11 — I can run through the ROI case and a suggested commercial structure (tiered commit + burst lane + pilot dedicated pool). If that works, I’ll loop in Ben to draft the commercial and Naomi for the ops plan.

Thanks —
Chloe

Subject: Fwd: Cardinal Health — renewal preflight checklist and next steps

Ben / Naomi —

Looping you both after Asha confirmed. High-level recommendation for the commercial and ops ask:

Commercial recommendation (draft numbers to discuss):
- Term: move to 18 months (Jan 1 2028 — Jun 30 2029) to enable deeper step discounts.
- Commit: base commit = 24B tokens over 18 months (~1.33B avg / month) to reflect current + runway growth; pricing: $0.0009 / token for committed tier.
- Burst lane: explicit +75% burst (on top of commit) priced at $0.0014 / token with a monthly cap.
- Prepay option: 8% discount on total if invoiced annually up front.

Ops/Delivery asks:
- Pilot dedicated pool for the CareOps inference pipeline for the first 90 days of Q2 to guarantee latency (SLO: p95 < 300ms). Naomi to scope required GPU counts and prefetch/caching config.
- SLA evidence: provide last 90 days SLO report and we’ll include a clause with uptime targets + credit ladder.

ROI example to show Asha on the call:
- Baseline: 2.1B tokens / month x current $0.0012 = $2.52M / month cost (on pay-as-you-go).
- Proposed commit: 1.33B tokens / month @ $0.0009 -> $1.197M / month, plus occasional burst at $0.0014. Over 18 months this is ~40% reduction vs uncommitted spend under expected patterns.

Ben — can you draft a succinct proposal PDF (one page commercial + one page ops appendix) and an annotated DocuSign packet? Asha asked for the 12 vs 18 month delta on the call — please include a two-column comparison. Naomi — can you validate feasibility of the dedicated pool numbers and the pilot ops checklist?

I’ll run the ROI slides briefly on the Wed call (11am ET).

Thanks —
Chloe

Asha / Chloe —

Thanks for the call earlier. Attached is a short proposal and the two-column 12 vs 18 month comparison you requested. Summary below:

Proposal highlights (attachment: cardinal_proposal_2028-01-13.pdf):
- Option A (12-mo): 16B commit, $0.00095 / token committed, burst at $0.0015, annual invoicing.
- Option B (18-mo recommended): 24B commit, $0.00090 / token committed, burst at $0.0014, 8% prepay discount available.
- Dedicated pilot: 90-day dedicated pool for CareOps (estimated 6 A100-equivalent GPUs), SLO p95 < 300ms guaranteed during pilot.

Next steps:
1) If you prefer Option B, reply with a confirmation line and we’ll issue DocuSign by EOD Mon 2028-01-16.
2) Billing: Cardinal Health Billing, please confirm whether you will take annual prepay or standard monthly invoice cadence.
3) Naomi to kick off pilot capacity sizing once we have term chosen.
